import sys

def project_point(p1, p2, p):
    # Unpack coordinates
    x1, y1 = p1
    x2, y2 = p2
    px, py = p

    # Direction vector
    vx = x2 - x1
    vy = y2 - y1

    # Vector from p1 to p
    dx = px - x1
    dy = py - y1

    # Dot products
    dot_v = vx * vx + vy * vy
    dot_dv = dx * vx + dy * vy

    # Parameter t
    t = dot_dv / dot_v

    # Projection point
    proj_x = x1 + t * vx
    proj_y = y1 + t * vy

    return proj_x, proj_y

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return

    x1, y1, x2, y2, px, py = map(float, data)
    p1 = (x1, y1)
    p2 = (x2, y2)
    p = (px, py)

    result = project_point(p1, p2, p)
    print(f"{result[0]:.10f} {result[1]:.10f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    idx += 2

        idx += 2
        
        # Direction vector of line
        dx = x2 - x1
        dy = y2 - y1
        
        # Vector from p1 to p
        ex = px - x1
        ey = py - y1
        
        # Parameter t = dot(e, d) / dot(d, d)
        t = (ex * dx + ey * dy) / (dx * dx + dy * dy)
        
        # Projection point
        proj_x = x1 + t * dx
        proj_y = y1 + t * dy
        
        results.append(f"{proj_x:.8f} {proj_y:.8f}")

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return

    vals = list(map(float, data))

    # Input may be:
    # x1 y1 x2 y2 x y
    # or
    # x1 y1
    # x2 y2
    # q
    # x y (repeated q times)
    #
    # Handle both, printing one projection per query point.

    if len(vals) == 6:
        x1, y1, x2, y2, x, y = vals
        dx = x2 - x1
        dy = y2 - y1
        t = ((x - x1) * dx + (y - y1) * dy) / (dx * dx + dy * dy)
        px = x1 + t * dx
        py = y1 + t * dy
        print(f"{px:.10f} {py:.10f}")
        return

    # AOJ-style multiple queries
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = vals[0], vals[1], vals[2], vals[3]
    q = int(vals[4])
    idx = 5

    dx = x2 - x1
    dy = y2 - y1
    denom = dx * dx + dy * dy

    out = []
    for _ in range(q):
        x = vals[idx]
        y = vals[idx + 1]
        idx += 2
        t = ((x - x1) * dx + (y - y1) * dy) / denom
        px = x1 + t * dx
        py = y1 + t * dy
        out.append(f"{px:.10f} {py:.10f}")

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
